titleFrame.title: Freedom Had a Price

background.why: the sand he won on and the place he comes back to

acting.note: holds the wooden sword at arm's length like it might bite
sips from his wine cup in his box

titleFrame.accentObject: the coin purse on the editor's belt

motifs.meaning: freedom that is only a token
the price that buys a free man back

cast.role: the winning gladiator (you); axis: a huge slab of a jaw under a tiny dented helmet

signatureGag.note: his sword hand keeps twitching for a hilt that is not there

arc.why: he is only calm with a weapon or pay in his hand: the reason some came back

cast.role: the man paying for the games; axis: a tiny head on a vast toga

signatureGag.note: sips from his wine cup before every decision, as if tasting the crowd

arc.why: the decisions about a man's freedom cost him one sip; he wins either way

progression.subject: the champion alone on the sand under the roaring stands
the champion's face
progression.why: emotion: he cannot believe he is alive

progression.subject: the stands waving cloths
over the champion's shoulder up at the editor's box
the editor sipping
progression.why: emotion: a man's freedom waits on one sip

span.text: and the man paying for the games hands you a wooden sword, the rudis.

progression.subject: the editor leaning down from his box with the wooden sword
the wooden sword landing in the champion's palm
progression.why: information: the rudis is the thing the narration names

progression.subject: the champion staring at it
progression.why: emotion: a toy for his life

progression.subject: pull back: the champion small on the sand holding it

span.text: It means you are done. Volunteers walked away.

progression.subject: the arena gate, volunteers trudging out
the champion following them with the wooden sword
the wooden sword snagged in the gate bars
progression.why: cause -> effect: the gate will not let him go

progression.subject: the champion's twitching sword hand
progression.why: emotion: his hand misses the fight

beats.accident: his wooden sword snags across the gate bars and yanks him back a step

span.text: A slave might be freed, though sources disagree.

progression.subject: the champion at the gate, the editor shrugging in his box
the iron collar on the champion's neck
progression.why: information: a slave's freedom is the open question

progression.subject: the champion's eyes sliding up to the editor

span.text: But some came back. Tiberius reportedly paid some retired fighters one hundred thousand sesterces each to return.

progression.subject: the champion outside the gate, looking back in
a ringed hand pouring coins into the champion's palm
progression.why: the decisive fact: the price of coming back

progression.subject: the champion's hand stops twitching and closes on the coins
the champion stepping back onto the sand

span.text: Freedom, it turns out, had a price.

progression.subject: the wooden sword left lying in the sand
progression.why: consequence: the freedom he put down

progression.subject: the editor sipping, satisfied
pull back: the champion back on the sand, the crowd roaring

climax.ecuSubject: the coins pouring into the champion's palm
climax.why: the one action the story turns on: freedom traded for pay
